notes.text:
Area192
Gateway must be the HSRP address
Both PC's must be able to ping the internet (1.1.1.1)
All Switches must be able to ping each other and switches
in Area10 from VLAN1 (192.168.1.0/24)
All devices are in VLAN 1
Ensure Area192_DSW1 is the spanning-tree root bridge for VLAN 1
Ensure all switches are set to negotiate a trunk link between each
other

notes.text:
Area10
Gateway must be the R1 Router
Both PC's must be able to ping the internet (1.1.1.1)
All switches must be able to ping each other and switches
in Area192 from VLAN1 Management (10.12.13.128/25)
Area10_PC1 is in VLAN 10 - Gateway is Area10_DSW1
Area10_PC2 is in VLAN 20 - Gateway is Area10_DSW1
Ensure Area10_DSW1 is the spanning-tree root bridge for
all vlans
Ensure all switches are set to a manual trunk link between each
other
